subject: Enquiry — barrister or chambers involvement in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (Great House Farm, Llandough, 1984–1988)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am researching the BP Properties Ltd v Buckler litigation. The public working evidence catalogue is at https://greathousefarmwiki.wordpress.com and the chronology index at https://dartboard.bucklerfamily.estate. I would be grateful for any guidance on tracing barristers or chambers that may have acted in that matter, and for preservation of any relevant records.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler
Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr research
